-- Final verification query
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1.cust_city
    FROM city_sales cs1
    JOIN city_sales cs2 ON cs1.cust_city = cs2.cust_city
    WHERE cs1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND cs2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND cs1.total_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (cs2.total_sales - cs1.total_sales) / cs1.total_sales >= 0.20
),
prod_city_qtr AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_qtr_total AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id, prod_name, calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(product_city_sales) as prod_total_sales
    FROM prod_city_qtr
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name, calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_total AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(prod_total_sales) as qtr_total
    FROM prod_qtr_total
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_share AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.prod_id, pq.prod_name, pq.calendar_quarter_id,
        pq.prod_total_sales,
        qt.qtr_total,
        100.0 * pq.prod_total_sales / qt.qtr_total as share_pct
    FROM prod_qtr_total pq
    JOIN quarter_total qt ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.prod_id, s1.prod_name,
        s1.share_pct as share_q4_2019,
        s2.share_pct as share_q4_2020,
        s2.share_pct - s1.share_pct as share_change_pct_points
    FROM prod_share s1
    JOIN prod_share s2 ON s1.prod_id = s2.prod_id
    WHERE s1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND s2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
prod_total_sales_all AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id, prod_name,
        SUM(prod_total_sales) as total_all
    FROM prod_qtr_total
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
prod_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id, prod_name, total_all,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_all DESC) as ntile_rank
    FROM prod_total_sales_all
)
SELECT 
    pr.prod_name, pr.total_all, pr.ntile_rank,
    ROUND(psc.share_q4_2019, 4) as share_q4_2019,
    ROUND(psc.share_q4_2020, 4) as share_q4_2020,
    ROUND(psc.share_change_pct_points, 6) as share_change_pct_points,
    ROUND(ABS(psc.share_change_pct_points), 6) as abs_change
FROM prod_ranked pr
JOIN prod_share_change psc ON pr.prod_id = psc.prod_id
WHERE pr.ntile_rank = 1
ORDER BY ABS(psc.share_change_pct_points) ASC
LIMIT 1
